description: Golden-run fixture for SSRAEKmeansSampling (flat, CPU-safe variant) on the micro DANINHAS dataset (5 classes, 806 train + 209 test images, a 10%-stratified replica of DATA/daninhas_full/ generated by scripts/make_micro_dataset.py). Used by tests/test_golden_run.py to catch integration regressions. See .specs/architecture/refactor-plan.md Phase 2 and .specs/quality/testing-strategy.md.
git_commit_note: Regenerated 2026-08-23 for the micro-dataset redefinition (chore/micro-10pct): DATA/daninhas_micro/ was redefined from a hand-picked 2-class/70-image subset to a 10%-stratified replica of DATA/daninhas_full/ (all 5 classes, both splits -- see .specs/adr/0004-micro-dataset-and-golden-run.md's 2026-08-23 amendment and files_config/params_micro.json's n_classes: 5). The commit hash above is the branch's parent commit at capture time, before this batch's own commits. The Phase-2 routing this fixture exercises (dalmax.cli -> dalmax.experiment.runner.ExperimentRunner -> dalmax.query_strategies.registry.build_strategy -> RepresentationStrategy(embedding_provider=SSRAEProvider(q=13), selection=FlatKMeansClosest())) is unchanged by the dataset redefinition; only the underlying pool of images (and therefore the embeddings/cluster assignments) changed.

legacy_phase1_values.note: Pre-Phase-2 values (tests/golden/ssrae_kmeans_micro_seed1.json as of git commit e60ae022f77aa981cdcc9cd3b5fa6d9057151060), kept for the historical record. Produced by the legacy core/query_strategies/ssrae_kmeans_sampling.py's KMeans(n_clusters=n, random_state=3, n_init=10) -- a hardcoded literal, independent of --seed. This is exactly the reproducibility hazard .claude/rules/reproducibility.md documents and Phase 2 fixes. Also predates the 2026-08-23 micro-dataset redefinition (see previous_micro_2class_values below), so its indices are not directly comparable to round_1_query_idxs_sorted above even setting the KMeans-seeding fix aside.

previous_micro_2class_values.note: Values recorded here for the historical record before the 2026-08-23 micro-dataset redefinition (chore/micro-10pct): DATA/daninhas_micro/ used to be a hand-picked 2-class (DATASET_BRACHIARIA, DATASET_GRAMINEA), 25-train/10-test-per-class subset (n_classes=2 in files_config/params_micro.json). It is now a 10%-stratified, all-5-class replica of DATA/daninhas_full/ (n_classes=5), giving a more realistic pre-lab end-to-end check. These are the Phase-2 (post-KMeans-seeding-fix) values, i.e. the fixture's own pre-redefinition round_1_query_idxs_sorted/results_json (not the even-older legacy_phase1_values above). Indices/metrics below are NOT reproducible against the current DATA/daninhas_micro/ or files_config/params_micro.json -- they describe the old dataset definition only.

notes: 2026-08-23 micro-dataset redefinition (chore/micro-10pct): DATA/daninhas_micro/ was redefined from the old hand-picked 2-class/70-image subset to a 10%-stratified replica of DATA/daninhas_full/ (all 5 classes, both splits, 806 train + 209 test images total), per user request for a more realistic pre-lab/pre-Colab end-to-end check on the no-GPU notebook. round_1_query_idxs_sorted changed from [14, 24, 37, 45, 47] (previous_micro_2class_values) to [23, 280, 415, 500, 645] purely because the underlying pool of images (and therefore SSRAE embeddings and k-means cluster assignments) changed -- FlatKMeansClosest's seed derivation (dalmax.seeding.derive_seed(config.seed, "selection")) itself is unchanged. See previous_micro_2class_values and legacy_phase1_values above for the pre-redefinition/pre-Phase-2 records.
Verified deterministic across 2 separate CPU processes on the local dev notebook (no GPU) on this commit: identical initial labeled idxs, query idxs, and results.json metrics.

Initial labeled idxs are unchanged from the RandomSampling fixture (tests/golden/random_sampling_micro_seed1.json): dataset.initialize_labels's shuffle logic and dalmax.seeding.seed_everything's np.random.seed(seed) call are both independent of --strategy_name.

Uses dalmax.embeddings.EmbeddingCache (dalmax/embeddings/cache.py): this run reads/writes results/cache/embeddings/daninhas_micro__ssrae__Q13__full__train__pool9ab386175096.pkl. The pool_hash (9ab386175096) legitimately differs from the pre-redefinition fixture's pool_hash (a629ae2d049d), since the actual unlabeled pool array changed size/content (from 40 images across 2 classes to 796 images across 5 classes) even though pool_hash's own definition (dalmax.embeddings.cache.pool_hash) is unchanged.

results_json round-0 metrics are identical to the RandomSampling fixture (both strategies share the same initial_labeled_idxs_sorted, and round 0 is trained/evaluated before either strategy's query() ever runs). Round-1 metrics are close but not identical (accuracy ties at 0.215311004784689; precision/f1 differ in the 3rd decimal, e.g. SSRAEKmeansSampling's round-1 precision 0.046358828781392365 vs RandomSampling's 0.046581707765918294): with only 1 CPU epoch on this dataset, the two strategies' differently-queried 5 ids still land on nearly the same round-1 metrics at this scale, same qualitative pattern observed for the pre-redefinition 2-class fixture (where both strategies' round-1 metrics were exactly identical). results.json also carries all_precision_macro/all_recall_macro/all_f1_macro, which this test does not assert on.
